title: Wave Interference
description: Demonstrates wave superposition with two sinusoidal waves and their resultant. Wave 1 (blue) and Wave 2 (green) have equal amplitude = 1.0 and frequency = 1.0, but differ by a phase of π (destructive interference). Their sum is shown as a thick yellow resultant wave. A ValueTracker animates the time parameter over 4π, making all three waves propagate in real time.

phase_difference.description: Phase offset between wave 1 and wave 2 (π = destructive)

what_to_modify: Change the phase_difference (0 for constructive, π/2 for partial), adjust amplitude or frequency, add more waves, show beat patterns by using slightly different frequencies, or add labels showing constructive/destructive regions.
